verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The mutation out-channel cannot auto-complete before work lands; import/remove batch synchronously with one-shot error termination and documented incremental behavior; graph-name validation prevents Variable and other invalid terms from reaching wildcard matching. The tests exercise the real adapter/store path, observe state from completion handlers, count actual delta calls, cover constructor and per-call chunk sizes, source errors, named/default graph addressing, and invalid destructive inputs. The exported option type and public skill documentation remain consistent. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found.
